tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud Developer | Enterprise E-Commerce & Integration
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms including SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring, RESTful APIs, microservices, SQL and database performance tuning, with proven delivery of data and API integrations between PIM, ERP and MDM systems. Certified SAP Commerce Cloud Developer with strong techno-functional expertise.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Enterprise eCommerce / IT Services
cover_en.hook: I am writing to express my strong interest in your enterprise eCommerce initiatives. With over 5 years of professional experience building, extending, and supporting large-scale commerce platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep technical expertise in enterprise architectures and integrations.

bullets.label: Enterprise eCommerce Delivery
bullets.text: Designed and implemented robust backend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) using Java and Spring, covering complex product catalogs, pricing, and customer data management for global channels.

bullets.label: API & Integration Architecture
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and headless APIs, while building optimized data pipelines between PIM, ERP, and MDM platforms using Profisee, Hotfolders, and DataHub.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Analysis
bullets.text: Bridged business and technical requirements by analysing integration problems, writing user stories and functional specifications, and collaborating closely with international stakeholders.

bullets.label: Performance & Quality
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles on CCv2, performed code reviews, and led database query refactoring to significantly reduce response latency and improve transaction speed.

cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German residence and work permit, and am serving my notice period with a last working day on 15 December 2026 (earliest start 16 December 2026). I welcome the opportunity to discuss how my expertise can drive your platform success.

tailoring.why_company: I want to bring my 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce and backend engineering experience from Rockwell Automation and Shell to your team. My deep background in building scalable Java/Spring applications, REST APIs, and complex PIM/ERP integrations enables me to deliver immediate value to your digital commerce ecosystem.
tailoring.motivation_short: Bringing 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce platform engineering, robust API development, and techno-functional delivery to your team.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello, I am an SAP Certified Commerce Developer with 5+ years of experience building enterprise e-commerce platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I am exploring new opportunities and would love to connect regarding your current openings.
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for your review. With 5+ years of professional experience engineering enterprise e-commerce solutions, APIs, and integrations at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am well-positioned to contribute to your technical initiatives.

I hold a valid German work permit and am available starting 16.12.2026.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
